::: {.hero-title}
Album Covers
:::

::: {.hero-sub}
Discover iconic album art, tracklists, and discographies. Hover over any album cover to zoom in, or search by artist and title!
:::

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load Bruce Springsteen albums
bruce <- read_csv("data/bruce/albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(artistName = "Bruce Springsteen") |>
  select(artistName, collectionName, releaseDate, trackCount, primaryGenreName, artworkUrl100)

# Load classic Hip-Hop albums
hiphop <- read_csv("data/hiphop_albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(artistName, collectionName, releaseDate, trackCount, primaryGenreName, artworkUrl100)

# Combine datasets and style fields
albums <- bind_rows(hiphop, bruce) |>
  mutate(
    releaseDate = as.Date(releaseDate),
    Cover = paste0(
      '<img src="', artworkUrl100,
      '" class="album-cover-img" width="60">'
    ),
    Artist = paste0('<span style="color: #38bdf8; font-weight: 600;">', artistName, '</span>'),
    Genre = case_when(
      str_detect(primaryGenreName, "Hip-Hop") ~ '<span class="badge" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ec4899, #8b5cf6); color: white; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 500;">Hip-Hop/Rap</span>',
      TRUE ~ '<span class="badge" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316, #ef4444); color: white; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 500;">Rock</span>'
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    Cover,
    Artist,
    Title = collectionName,
    `Release Date` = releaseDate,
    Tracks = trackCount,
    Genre
  )

datatable(
  albums,
  escape = FALSE,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 7,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  )
)
```
